 Occupational English Test

WRITING SUB-TEST:          MEDICINE
TIME ALLOWED:              READING TIME: 5 MINUTES
                           WRITING TIME: 40 MINUTES

Read the case notes and complete the writing task which follows.

Notes:
You are a GP in a Newtown City Clinic. Mrs Karen Jackson is your patient for 10 years. Now
they are planning for moving to Park Ville.
PATIENT DETAILS:
Name:     Mrs Karen Jackson
Age:      36 years

Patient history:
occupation - hairdresser salon manager.
married - has 1 child ( 28 months daughter )
non-smoker.
drinks alcohol. not during pregnancy
participates in recreational sports.
BMI: normal

Family history:
father - died at age 70, cancer. mother -
HTN
brother - diabetes mellitus


Medical History:

1998:
painful period till first miscarriage.
1999:
clavicle fracture.
April 2008:
first miscarriage on 9 week.
August 2008:
second miscarriage on 10 week.
July 2018:
daughter born after long labor
( Episiotomy - forceps delivery )
normal weight
gestational diabetes.
 July 2018 to June 2019:
mild anxiety
pt refuse medications ( due to breast feeding )
anxiety improved when baby started sleeping 6 hr/night

01/08/2020:
mild anxiety
pt refuse medications also
planning for another child
counselled, lifestyle changes - pt refuse

10/08/2020:
confirmed pregnancy
anxious - how to cope with baby

22/08/2020:
   anxiety - due to moving to Park Ville
anxious reg loss her work, family, relatives
Poor sleep, poor appetite
pregnancy w/o complication
pt requested home delivery - not recommended due to previous pregnancy complications
taking OTC multivitamins to prevent miscarriage




Writing Task:

Using the information given in the case notes, write a letter of referral to patient’s new GP in

Park Ville, mentioning her relevant medical history and request further management for her
       ●




anxiety. Address the letter to Dr Dev Desai, General practitioner, Park Ville.
       ●




In your answer:
       ●




●   Expand the relevant notes into complete sentences
●   Do not use note form

●   Use letter format

The body of the letter should be approximately 180–200 words.
